text.p: Macmin NL said on Wednesday it has dicovered high-grade silver mineralisation at the Twin Hills prospect near Texas in southeast Queensland state.
A drilling programme at Twin Hills had returned silver values of up to 54 ounces a tonne, supported by gold values of up to 2.99 grammes per tonne (g/t) at shallow depths, it said.

The mineralisation was intersected over wide intersections, the company said. One hole, THP 40, intersected the highest silver grades so far encountered, returning 10 metres downhole of 1,158 g/t silver, Macmin said.
Macmin said it would continue to drill near Texas, where further silver soil anomolies exist.
The manager of the project, Hunter Exploration, is earning a 50 percent interest, Macmin said.
